title: Decrease Font Size (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Decrease Font Size applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Decrease Font Size (BtnDecreaseFontSize) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Decrease Font Size moves the selection down the size ladder
scenarios.expected: Decreasing the probe text moves its font size below the 18pt default along PowerPoint's size ladder, leaving text and geometry unchanged.
